prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1175; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while the patient's vehicle was turning left, with resulting right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the kind and force of the impact described. No prior injury to the same body area is known to this provider. Over the course of care the patient attended 22 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for this type of shoulder injury. Physical examination revealed findings that support a soft tissue injury to the shoulder, including limited abduction and tenderness over the rotator cuff region, while several other tests, including neurological screening and strength testing of the upper extremity, returned normal results. Treatment consisted of guided physical therapy, a home exercise program, and anti-inflammatory medication. Billing records reviewed for this summary show no duplicated or repeated charges for services. Current status is improving, with continued monitoring and a plan for reassessment at the next scheduled visit.
